info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Carrental Reservations Returns-v2-spec
info.description: The Car Rental Reservations Returns API allows users to access a comprehensive list of return reservations for car rentals. This endpoint is designed to facilitate the retrieval of detailed information regarding the status and specifics of each return reservation. Typically utilized by car rental agencies and management systems, it supports scenarios such as tracking return progress, managing customer returns, and optimizing fleet operations. Developers can leverage this API to enhance their applications with real-time data on rental returns.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about all returns associated with reservations. Use this to track any returned reservations and their statuses.
